notes: Shape estimated as a box for 36 part(s): FID1, FID2, FID3, J16, J18, JP1, JP2, JP3, JP4, JP5, JP6, JP7 .... Their fit can't be guaranteed: add a 3D model, set jig.heights, or leave them out with jig.ignore.
Pockets follow each part's 3D shape; a hold pocket's floor is the part's own top, so every part touches its pocket as the board lands (jig.hold_depth_offset_mm +0.00 mm).
Two-jig workflow: put the PCB top side up in the placement jig, fit the parts, put this holding jig on top (pockets down), turn the stack over, lift off the placement jig and solder from above.

Fit check (284 parts, their 3D shapes): nothing touches on the way in; all 14 hand-soldered parts touch their pockets as the board lands on the support (within 0.01 mm) and are held on all four sides (0.19 to 0.30 mm of play); held by the part beside it, too close for a jig wall between them: JP1 +y against JP2 (0.26 mm), JP2 +y against JP3 (0.26 mm), JP2 -y against JP1 (0.19 mm), JP3 +y against JP4 (0.26 mm), JP3 -y against JP2 (0.19 mm), JP4 +y against JP5 (0.26 mm) ...; the holding jig closes over the placement jig without touching it. Estimated (box) shapes: FID1, FID2, FID3, J16, J18, JP1, JP2, JP3, JP4, JP5.
Batch of 4 boards: a jig set for all of them does not fit the 220 x 220 mm printer bed, so each jig holds 2 boards (1 x 2); print 2 sets.
